manifest.name: dsh-fork-merge
manifest.description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin that turns a forked session's work into a reviewed merge packet, injects it back into the parent session after human confirmation, and can replace model-visible history ranges.

readme.text:
[English](./README.en.md) | **中文**

> 给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 补上「会话分叉之后能收束回主会话」的能力。
>
> **只做收束，不做分叉。** 分叉 DSH 自带；本项目解决的是分叉之后那一半——分支干的活怎么回到主会话，而且不污染主会话上下文。

---

DSH Desktop 支持会话分叉：从一个对话分出两条，各自往下跑。但只有「发散」，没有「收束」——分叉出去那个会话里改了什么文件、跑了什么命令、测出什么结果，主会话一概不知道。你只能自己看一遍再手打一段摘要贴回去。

这个插件把这一步自动化，但**不自动注入**：

```
分支会话（改代码、跑测试、踩坑）
   │  /merge
   ▼
收束包草稿（packet.json / packet.md / evidence.jsonl，落盘可审阅）

中间那道人工确认闸门是刻意的，见 [设计取舍](#设计取舍)。

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 确定性起草 | `/merge` 从分支的**全量事件**（`sessionController.inspect()`，含 `tool/result`）提取证据，**不调用模型**、不消耗额度、不受 429 影响 |
| 可选模型摘要 | `/merge --summary` 才花一次模型调用写语义结论；失败自动回落确定性草稿，不阻塞 |
| 人工确认注入 | `/merge-confirm` 是唯一的注入入口；模型没有对应工具，不能替你批准 |
| Surface 替换 | `/merge-replace` 用收束包替换模型可见的历史区间；**事件日志和用户 transcript 不变** |
| L2 冲突裁决 | `--summary` 时由模型标出分支与主会话对同一事实的不同取值；插件拦截未裁决的确认、记录人工裁决，并把裁决结果写进注入正文 |
| 幂等 / 过期保护 | 注入消息 id 固定为 `dsh-fork-merge:<requestId>`（替换投递为 `…:replace`），重试天然幂等；分支或主会话有新增则判过期拒绝 |
| 可撤回 | 待投递的从 inbox 移除；已消费的追加撤回说明（撤回是终态） |

| 命令 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `/merge [branch-session-id]` | 读取分支全量事件，生成确定性收束包草稿。不调模型、不注入。省略 id 时自动选唯一分叉 |
| `/merge ... --summary` | 额外调用一次模型生成语义摘要；失败自动回落 |
| `/merge-confirm <id>` | 人工确认后注入（不唤醒 agent，下一个 step 生效） |
| `/merge-redraft <id> [--summary]` | 分支有新增时重新起草 |
| `/merge-status [id]` | 查看状态、游标、过期情况 |
| `/merge-cancel <id>` | 取消从未投递的草稿 |
| `/merge-undo <id>` | 待处理则移除；已消费则追加撤回说明 |
| `/merge-replace <id> <start-seq> <end-seq>` | 用收束包替换模型视图区间（人工指定；日志不动） |
| `/merge-resolve <id> <key> <parent\|branch\|both\|custom> [value]` | 裁决 `--summary` 标出的 L2 冲突；裁决结果会写进之后注入的正文 |

产物落在 `<工作区>/.dsh/merge-packets/<request-id>/`：

- `packet.json` — 机器可读：身份、游标、claims、投递状态
- `packet.md` — 人读的完整收束包
- `evidence.jsonl` — 确定性证据（工具调用、命令、错误）

要求：**Web 或 Desktop profile**、DSH `0.2.1-rc.5`、Node `>=22.19.0`、pnpm。

> ⚠️ **必须用 Web / Desktop profile。** 插件依赖 `sessionController` 服务，而它由 `dsh-web-app` 提供；`headless` / `acp` / `sdk` 等 profile 没有这个服务。Cordis 的 `inject` 不满足时插件**不激活也不报错**——装完你会看不到任何 `/merge*` 命令，且没有任何错误提示。

**方式一：从本地目录装（推荐，当前未发布到 npm）**

```bash
git clone https://github.com/V-dev-388/dsh-fork-merge.git
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile 名> add /绝对路径/dsh-fork-merge
```

`dsh plugin add` 会把包追加进 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 层栈，其 `cordis.patch.yml` 自动插入插件行。装完重启 DSH。

**方式二：在 DSH 里让 agent 装**

```
plugin_manager install_bundle，target 指向本仓库的绝对路径
```

**升级 / 换机**：`engines.dsh` 是**精确锁**（当前 `0.2.1-rc.5`）。DSH 升级后这个插件会**被动失效**——bundle 被跳过，只在启动时往 stderr 打一行 `skippedBundles`，GUI 里看不到任何提示。届时改 `package.json` 的 `engines.dsh` 与 app 版本严格一致再重新安装；若确认兼容，也可用 `dsh plugin allow-version` 给这个精确版本对开豁免。

无配置文件。全部行为由命令参数决定。

可选的环境约定：

- 收束包落在**当前会话的工作区目录**（`session.header.cwd`）下的 `.dsh/merge-packets/`，不进 `$DSH_HOME`，不新增事件类型。
- 插件声明 `inject = ['commands', 'sessionController', 'llm', 'sessions']`；`llm` 只在 `--summary` 路径上被使用。

**为什么必须人工确认？** 收束包会进入主会话上下文，模型据此继续工作。自动合并等于让分支的结论不经审阅就改变主会话的判断依据。参考实现 `pi-context-tree` 的 `/merge --squash` 也是这个形态：起草 → 人确认 → 才落地。插件刻意**不注册任何 agent 工具**，模型没有注入通道。

**为什么默认不调模型？** 第一版把「模型生成语义摘要」当成必需步骤，结果模型 429 会让整个 `/merge` 失败——而文件、命令、测试结果这些证据早就提取完了。改成「确定性核心 + 可选模型增强」后，`/merge` 零额度依赖。模型只写语义字段，文件和命令始终来自确定性证据，不会被编造。

**为什么不用 `session-reference`？** 它是有损投影：只留 user/assistant 文本，丢弃全部 `tool/result`、`tool-call`、`reasoning`、注入上下文，上限 3 条引用 / 64KB。它是「回顾」，不是「收束」。本插件用 `ctx.sessionController.inspect()` 读全量事件。

**为什么不做事件级真合并？** 无 API（`mergeSession` / `importEvents` / `adoptEvents` 全零命中），子会话继承父会话 seq 空间且无重编号工具，手写重编号可能损坏会话文件。投入产出比差，已明确排除。

**为什么把 `engines.dsh` 精确锁死？** 插件用的是 DSH 内部接口（Surface 层、`agent.inject()`、v4 消息格式），这些不是稳定公开 API。放宽成版本范围等于对没测过的版本做兼容承诺，而失效方式又是静默的（bundle 被跳过，只有 stderr 一行）。宁可精确锁死、升级时显式改一次，也不要假装兼容。

| 项 | 结论 |
|---|---|
| 插件层能否发起 `surfaceOp: 'replace'` | ✅ 可以。提交成功、`replaceGeneration` +1、原事件仍在日志 |
| 同区间二次 replace | ❌ 被拒。插件先抛 `surface/range-absent`（`The selected range is no longer on the model surface…`）；即使绕过插件，DSH 底层也会拒绝 |
| 替换 system head（node 0） | ❌ 被拒，受保护 |
| v4 消息 `source.kind: 'plugin'` | ❌ 拒绝。必须用生产者自有 kind（本项目 `dsh-fork-merge`）；否则注入当下成功、下一轮模型请求才报错 |
| `agent.inject()` 的粒度 | 只写 `agent/inbox/spliced`，下一个被接纳的 step 才成为 `user/message`。「注入成功」≠「格式合法」 |
| 判断分叉标记 | 只看 `data.inherited === true`。压缩也会产生同类型但 `data: {}` 的 `session/end-seed`，看类型必误判 |
| 分叉边界索引 | marker 自己就坐在 `inheritedEventCount` 索引上（不是 `-1`） |
| 替换式投递的撤回 | 无原生 unreplace，撤回只能追加说明，不承诺恢复原模型视图 |

```bash
git clone https://github.com/V-dev-388/dsh-fork-merge.git
cd dsh-fork-merge
npm test          # 57 项，零第三方依赖（node --test）
node --check index.js

- **Host-only、零运行时依赖**：只用 Node 内置模块和公开 Host 服务，不 import 任何第三方包。
- 测试覆盖：证据投影与路径过滤、收束包规范化与按节预算渲染、过期检测、投递幂等与撤回、Surface replace 的区间解析与 system head 保护、L2 冲突闸门与裁决结果投递、以及带假 Host context 的完整命令流程（含 `/merge-replace` 端到端）。

源码结构：

| 文件 | 职责 |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | 插件入口，注册 8 个命令，不注册工具 |
| `lib/projection.js` | 血缘校验、分支切片、确定性证据提取、父会话近期上下文 |
| `lib/draft.js` | 确定性草稿（零模型）与可选的模型摘要路径 |
| `lib/packet.js` | JSON schema、规范化、Markdown 渲染、按节预算 inline |
| `lib/store.js` | 工作区 `.dsh/merge-packets/` 原子落盘 |
| `lib/delivery.js` | 幂等注入、定位、撤回、语义游标 |
| `lib/surface.js` | replace 区间推导、head 保护、替换提交 |
| `lib/conflict.js` | L2 claims 比对、人工裁决、确认闸门 |
| `lib/commands.js` | 命令编排；`/merge-confirm` 是唯一注入入口 |

- [`deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype)（MIT）——官方多会话并行原型。它不做分叉、不做冲突处理、不用 Surface 层，不解决本项目的问题；但本插件借用了它验证的三条做法：`sessionController.inspect()` 读全量事件、`inject` 不唤醒、inline 正文加 `read:` 指针。
- [`navbytes/pi-context-tree`](https://github.com/navbytes/pi-context-tree) —— `/merge --squash` 的「人工确认 + decision record + `/undo`」形态是本项目的直接参照。宿主 `pi` 与 DSH 依赖同源，但数据结构不同（`pi` 是原生树，DSH 是扁平事件日志 + header 里的 `parentSession`），不能直接移植。
- [`robiteame/dsh-session-tree-extension`](https://github.com/robiteame/dsh-session-tree-extension) —— 给 DSH 做了分叉（`/tree` `/fork` `/clone`），**无 merge**。本项目不重复造分叉。

**English** | [中文](./README.md)

> Merge a forked DeepSeek Harness session's work back into its parent — without polluting the parent's context.
>
> **Merge only, no fork.** DSH already forks sessions. This plugin covers the other half: what the branch actually did, brought back into the parent session.

---

DSH Desktop lets you fork a conversation into two and run them independently. But there is only divergence, no convergence: the parent session has no idea what the fork changed, ran, or learned. You read the branch yourself and paste a summary back by hand.

This plugin automates that step — and deliberately **never injects automatically**:

```
Branch session (edits code, runs tests, hits walls)
   │  /merge
   ▼
Merge packet draft (packet.json / packet.md / evidence.jsonl, on disk, reviewable)
That human gate is intentional; see [Design tradeoffs](#design-tradeoffs).

| Capability | Detail |
|---|---|
| Deterministic drafting | `/merge` projects evidence from the branch's **full event log** (`sessionController.inspect()`, including `tool/result`). **No model call**, no quota, immune to rate limits |
| Optional model summary | Only `/merge --summary` spends one model call for semantic conclusions; on failure it falls back to the deterministic body instead of failing |
| Human-gated injection | `/merge-confirm` is the only injection path; the agent has no tool that could approve on your behalf |
| Surface replacement | `/merge-replace` swaps a model-visible history range for the packet; **the event log and your transcript stay untouched** |
| L2 conflict arbitration | Under `--summary`, the model flags where branch and parent assert different values for the same fact; the plugin blocks confirmation until a human rules, records the ruling, and writes the chosen value into the injected body |
| Idempotent / staleness-guarded | Injection message id is fixed at `dsh-fork-merge:<requestId>` (`…:replace` for replacement delivery); branch or parent drift makes the draft stale and refuses confirmation |
| Reversible | Pending packets are removed from the

| Command | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `/merge [branch-session-id]` | Read the fork's full event log and draft a deterministic packet. No model call, never injects. Picks the only fork when the id is omitted |
| `/merge ... --summary` | Opt into one model call for the semantic summary; falls back to deterministic on failure |
| `/merge-confirm <id>` | Human gate: inject the reviewed packet (does not wake the agent; lands on the next step) |
| `/merge-redraft <id> [--summary]` | Re-draft after the branch gained events |
| `/merge-status [id]` | Show state, cursors, and staleness |
| `/merge-cancel <id>` | Cancel a draft that was never injected |
| `/merge-undo <id>` | Remove a pending packet, or append a revocation notice after it was consumed |
| `/merge-replace <id> <start-seq> <end-seq>` | Replace an explicit model-surface range with the packet. Log untouched |
| `/merge-resolve <id> <key> <parent\|branch\|both\|custom> [value]` | Rule on an L2 conflict flagged by `--summary`; the ruling is written into the body injected afterwards |

Packets are stored in `<workspace>/.dsh/merge-packets/<request-id>/`:

- `packet.json` — machine-readable: identity, cursors, claims, delivery state
- `packet.md` — the full human-readable packet
- `evidence.jsonl` — deterministic evidence (tool calls, commands, errors)

Requirements: a **Web or Desktop profile**, DSH `0.2.1-rc.5`, Node `>=22.19.0`, pnpm.

> ⚠️ **Web / Desktop profile is required.** The plugin depends on the `sessionController` service, which `dsh-web-app` provides; `headless` / `acp` / `sdk` profiles do not have it. When a Cordis `inject` is unsatisfied the plugin **neither activates nor reports an error** — after installing you would see no `/merge*` commands at all, with no diagnostic.

**Option 1: install from a local checkout (recommended; not published to npm)**

```bash
git clone https://github.com/V-dev-388/dsh-fork-merge.git
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add /absolute/path/to/dsh-fork-merge
```

`dsh plugin add` appends the package to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` layer stack, and its `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the plugin row. Restart DSH afterwards.

**Option 2: let the agent install it**

**Upgrading / moving machines**: `engines.dsh` is an **exact pin** (currently `0.2.1-rc.5`). After a DSH upgrade this plugin **fails passively** — the bundle is skipped and only one `skippedBundles` line reaches stderr, with nothing shown in the GUI. At that point set `engines.dsh` in `package.json` to exactly the running app version and reinstall; if you have confirmed compatibility you can instead grant an exemption for that exact version pair with `dsh plugin allow-version`.

No config file. Behavior is entirely driven by command arguments.

Conventions worth knowing:

- Packets live under the **current session's workspace** (`session.header.cwd`) in `.dsh/merge-packets/`. They never enter `$DSH_HOME`, and the plugin creates no new session event type.
- The plugin declares `inject = ['commands', 'sessionController', 'llm', 'sessions']`; `llm` is only touched by the `--summary` path.

**Why require human confirmation?** A merge packet becomes part of the parent session's context, and the model acts on it. Automatic merging would let a branch's conclusions change the parent's basis for reasoning without review. The reference implementation `pi-context-tree` has the same shape with `/merge --squash`: draft → confirm → commit. This plugin deliberately registers **no agent tools at all**, so the model has no injection channel.

**Why no model call by default?** The first version treated "the model writes the semantic summary" as a required step, so a 429 on the model failed the entire `/merge` — even though the files, commands, and test results had already been extracted. Making it "deterministic core + optional model enrichment" removed the quota dependency from `/merge`. The model only writes semantic fields; files and commands always come from deterministic evidence and cannot be invented.

**Why not `session-reference`?** It is a lossy projection: user/assistant text only, dropping all `tool/result`, `tool-call`, `reasoning`, and injected context, capped at 3 references / 64KB. It is a *recap*, not a *merge*. This plugin reads the full log through `ctx.sessionController.inspect()`.

**Why no event-level true merge?** There is no API (`mergeSession` / `importEvents` / `adoptEvents` all have zero hits), fork children inherit the parent's seq space with no renumbering utility, and hand-rolled renumbering risks corrupting session files. Poor return on effort; explicitly out of scope.

**Why is `engines.dsh` pinned exactly?** The plugin uses DSH internals (the Surface layer, `agent.inject()`, the v4 message format), which are not a stable public API. Widening it to a range would promise compatibility with versions nobody tested — and the failure mode is silent (the bundle is skipped, with one stderr line). An exact pin plus one explicit edit per upgrade beats pretending to be compatible.

| Item | Result |
|---|---|
| Can a plugin issue `surfaceOp: 'replace'`? | ✅ Yes. Commits, `replaceGeneration` +1, original events remain in the log |
| Second replace of the same range | ❌ Refused. The plugin raises `surface/range-absent` first (`The selected range is no longer on the model surface…`); DSH itself refuses it too, even if the plugin check is bypassed |
| Replacing the system head (node 0) | ❌ Refused; protected |
| v4 message with `source.kind: 'plugin'` | ❌ Refused. Requires a producer-owned kind (this plugin uses `dsh-fork-merge`); otherwise injection succeeds and the *next* model request fails |
| `agent.inject()` granularity | Writes only `agent/inbox/spliced`; becomes `user/message` on the next admitted step. "Injected" ≠ "well-formed" |
| Detecting a fork marker | Only `data.inherited === true`. Compaction also emits a same-type `session/end-seed` with `data: {}`; matching on type misidentifies it |
| Fork boundary index | The marker sits **at** `inheritedEventCount` (not `-1`) |
| Undoing a replacement delivery | No native unreplace; revocation can only append a notice, never promise the original model view is restored |

cd dsh-fork-merge
npm test          # 57 tests, zero third-party dependencies (node --test)

- **Host-only, zero runtime dependencies**: Node built-ins and public Host services only; no third-party imports.
- Test coverage: evidence projection and path filtering, packet normalization and section-budgeted rendering, staleness detection, delivery idempotency and revocation, Surface replace range resolution and system head protection, the L2 conflict gate and delivery of the ruling, and the full command flow against a fake Host context (including `/merge-replace` end to end).

| File | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Plugin entry; registers 8 commands, no tools |
| `lib/projection.js` | Lineage validation, branch slicing, deterministic evidence, recent parent context |
| `lib/draft.js` | Deterministic draft (model-free) plus the optional model summary path |
| `lib/packet.js` | JSON schema, normalization, Markdown rendering, section-budgeted inline body |
| `lib/store.js` | Atomic persistence under the workspace `.dsh/merge-packets/` |
| `lib/delivery.js` | Idempotent injection, location, revocation, semantic cursor |
| `lib/surface.js` | Replace range derivation, head protection, replacement commit |
| `lib/conflict.js` | L2 claims comparison, human arbitration, confirmation gate |
| `lib/commands.js` | Command orchestration; `/merge-confirm` is the only injection entry |

- [`deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype) (MIT) — the official multi-session parallel prototype. It does not fork, does not handle conflicts, and does not use the Surface layer, so it does not solve this problem; but this plugin borrows three practices it validated: reading full events via `sessionController.inspect()`, `inject` without waking, and inline bodies with `read:` pointers.
- [`navbytes/pi-context-tree`](https://github.com/navbytes/pi-context-tree) — its `/merge --squash` shape (human confirmation + decision record + `/undo`) is the direct reference for this design. The `pi` host shares a dependency with DSH, but the data structures differ (`pi` uses a native tree; DSH uses a flat event log plus `parentSession` in the header), so it cannot be ported directly.
- [`robiteame/dsh-session-tree-extension`](https://github.com/robiteame/dsh-session-tree-extension) — brings forking to DSH (`/tree` `/fork` `/clone`) with **no merge**. This project does not rebuild forking.
[MIT](./LICENSE)
